cues.zh: 最後是「二次感謝」， 這部份我最喜歡，

cues.text: And the second thankfulness is my favorite part
cues.en: And the second thankfulness is my favorite part
cues.zh: 最後是「二次感謝」， 這部份我最喜歡，

cues.text: because it's so easy to do and it's very powerful.
cues.en: because it's so easy to do and it's very powerful.
cues.zh: 因為這很容易做到，卻非常有力量。

cues.text: What you're trying to do here is reinforce and reward the behavior
cues.en: What you're trying to do here is reinforce and reward the behavior
cues.zh: 你要做的是強化並獎勵對方的行為，

cues.text: so that they keep doing it.
cues.en: so that they keep doing it.
cues.zh: 讓他們願意繼續這麼做。

cues.text: Most of us don't do things that are painful or unpleasant,
cues.en: Most of us don't do things that are painful or unpleasant,
cues.zh: 大多數人不會去做 那些痛苦或令人不舒服的事，

cues.text: like giving feedback,
cues.en: like giving feedback,
cues.zh: 例如給別人回饋，

cues.text: unless there's some sort of a benefit for doing it.
cues.en: unless there's some sort of a benefit for doing it.
cues.zh: 除非這麼做能帶來某種好處。

cues.text: So when the conversation's over, send them a quick text.
cues.en: So when the conversation's over, send them a quick text.
cues.zh: 因此，談話結束後， 傳一則簡短訊息給對方：

cues.text: "Thank you."
cues.en: "Thank you."
cues.zh: 「謝謝你。」

cues.text: Or do what one of my colleagues did when I gave him tough feedback,
cues.en: Or do what one of my colleagues did when I gave him tough feedback,
cues.zh: 或者像我的一位同事那樣。 我曾經給他一個不太中聽的回饋，

cues.text: he wrote me a handwritten thank-you card.
cues.en: he wrote me a handwritten thank-you card.
cues.zh: 之後他親手寫了一張感謝卡給我。

cues.text: Just do something that makes it feel like it was worth the risk to tell you.
cues.en: Just do something that makes it feel like it was worth the risk to tell you.
cues.zh: 你只要做些事情，讓對方覺得冒著風險 告訴你真話，是值得的。

cues.text: So it's thankfulness, acknowledgment, commitment,
cues.en: So it's thankfulness, acknowledgment, commitment,
cues.zh: 總之，就是感謝、確認、承諾，

cues.text: and then a second thankfulness.
cues.en: and then a second thankfulness.
cues.zh: 然後再次感謝。

cues.text: Do this consistently
cues.en: Do this consistently
cues.zh: 持續這麼做，

cues.text: and you're going to be amazed at what you learn
cues.en: and you're going to be amazed at what you learn
cues.zh: 你會驚訝於自己能學到多少東西，

cues.text: and the ways that it starts to benefit your relationships.
cues.en: and the ways that it starts to benefit your relationships.
cues.zh: 也會驚訝這件事 為你的人際關係帶來多少好處。

cues.text: There is likely someone in your life who cares about you
cues.en: There is likely someone in your life who cares about you
cues.zh: 你的生命中，很可能就有這麼一個人， 他在乎你，而且有些話想告訴你。

cues.text: and has something to tell you that you might not want to hear,
cues.en: and has something to tell you that you might not want to hear,
cues.zh: 那些話可能是你不太想聽的，

cues.text: but it could change your life if you did.
cues.en: but it could change your life if you did.
cues.zh: 如果你願意聽， 可能就會改變你的人生。

cues.text: If you want the benefits of that feedback,
cues.en: If you want the benefits of that feedback,
cues.zh: 如果你想得到這些回饋帶來的好處，

cues.text: ask for it and then respond with tact.
cues.en: ask for it and then respond with tact.
cues.zh: 就主動去問，然後用得體的方式回應。

cues.text: I have seen it do wonders for so many people, including me.
cues.en: I have seen it do wonders for so many people, including me.
cues.zh: 我親眼看過這為很多人 帶來奇妙的改變，包括我自己。

cues.text: As I was preparing for today,
cues.en: As I was preparing for today,
cues.zh: 在準備今天這場演講時，

cues.text: I shared a draft with my sister and this is what she told me.
cues.en: I shared a draft with my sister and this is what she told me.
cues.zh: 我把演講草稿拿給我姊姊看， 這就是她告訴我的話。

cues.text: She said,
cues.en: She said,
cues.zh: 她說：

cues.text: "Chris, you've completely flipped the way that you talk to me,
cues.en: "Chris, you've completely flipped the way that you talk to me,
cues.zh: 「克里斯，你跟我說話的方式 完全不一樣了，

cues.text: and I can't even remember what you used to sound like.
cues.en: and I can't even remember what you used to sound like.
cues.zh: 我甚至已經想不起來 你以前說話的語氣。

cues.text: I can be completely myself around you, even though we're so different."
cues.en: I can be completely myself around you, even though we're so different."
cues.zh: 現在跟你在一起，我可以完全做自己， 即使我們兩個是如此不同。」

cues.text: So go out and get a tough piece of feedback
cues.en: So go out and get a tough piece of feedback
cues.zh: 因此，去找一個真正在乎你的人，

cues.text: from someone who cares about you
cues.en: from someone who cares about you
cues.zh: 請他告訴你一些你不太想聽的真心話，

cues.text: and let it change your life.
cues.en: and let it change your life.
cues.zh: 讓這些話改變你的人生。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝大家。

cues.text: (Cheers and applause)
cues.en: (Cheers and applause)
cues.zh: （歡呼與掌聲）
